source: SEC EDGAR 8-K Item 2.02 Exhibit 99 (earnings press-release text)
license: US public records; press-release text is company-authored (analysis/archival is standard practice; no SEC reuse restriction)

field_map.accession: SEC accession (dedup key). ONE ROW PER ACCESSION from v1.0.1352 (2026-11-11): a JOINT filing (parent + subsidiaries, one accession, N registrants — EDGAR's getcurrent feed lists it once per registrant) is one row whose cik/companyName/ticker are the PRIMARY registrant (first feed entry with a resolved ticker, else the first entry). Rows written before v1.0.1352 hold a joint filing once per registrant (77 accessions / 114 extra lines, 2026-07..11); the readers (readEarnings8kHistory, readEarnings8kHistoryWindow via mergeCoRegistrants) fold them into the same shape. Append-only: the old lines are not rewritten.
field_map.coRegistrants: JOINT filings only — the other registrants of the same accession as [{cik, companyName, ticker}], feed order, each ticker resolved the same exact-CIK way (null = unlisted). Absent, not [], for a single-registrant filing.
field_map.ticker: exact CIK match vs SEC company_tickers.json; null = unlisted filer (never guessed). Entity key with accession.
field_map.acceptanceDatetime: the getcurrent feed entry's <updated> timestamp (ISO with offset) — when this feed made the filing publicly visible; the lookahead-free event time for gate-2 work. filedAt remains the date-only field.
field_map.text: extracted exhibit plain text (truncated at 30k chars with truncated flag)

confidence_model: as-filed text; extraction is deterministic parsing (gate-1 verified 2026-07-04); sentiment/tone are DERIVED later, never stored as fact here
sentiment: not stored raw; L-M tone computed downstream (SIGNAL-class, gated)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
